description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

*   If the production studio was created by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, check the value of the response parameter CasterId to obtain the ID.
*   If the production studio was created by using the ApsaraVideo Live console, obtain the ID on the **Production Studio Management** page. To go to the page, log on to the **ApsaraVideo Live console** and click **Production Studios** in the left-side navigation pane.

>  You can find the ID of the production studio in the Instance ID/Name column.

description.zh:
需要播放切换的节目ID。
>通过查看[AddShowIntoShowList](~~2848051~~)或[DescribeShowList](~~2848054~~)接口的返回参数获取ShowId值。
description.en:
The ID of the episode that you want to switch to.

>  You can call the [AddShowIntoShowList](~~2848051~~) or [DescribeShowList](~~2848054~~) operation and check the value of the response parameter ShowId to obtain the ID.

descriptions.zh:
添加节目完成开启直播后，可调用本接口切换节目。使用API添加节目，请参见[添加一个节目到节目单](~~2848051~~)。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
